Plus, enjoy on-site parking, a pet friendly and 100% smoke free athmosphere, and Wi-Fi throughout the building as well as in each unit. Contact our leasing team to schedule a private tour of this can't-miss building in Downtown Stamford!

desc:
Welcome to The Davenport, "a new classic". Built in 1915 by Robert Francis Adams and J. Hawley Ingalls as a hotel and completely remodeled and converted into luxury apartments by Empire Residential, LLC in 2023. The Davenport is a Stamford historical landmark.

The Davenport boasts 27 modern, elegant apartments in the heart of Downtown Stamford. All units are equipped with sleek, modern kitchens, elegant bathrooms with contemporary tile work and an overall classic yet modern aesthetic that is sure to please the most discerning taste. In unit laundry complete this Downtown oasis.

Community features include: modern elevator, control access, top of the line camera system and Amazon Lockers.

UCONN Stamford is a short walk away, as well as Mill River Park - home of the famous Alive At Five and various world class events throughout the year. Renowned area restaurants are mere feet away as well as the Stamford Town Center, Target, movie theater and more. Stamford Train Station (Metro North, Amtrak) is also within walking distance.

The Davenport is an apartment community located in Fairfield County and the 06901 ZIP Code. This area is served by the Stamford attendance zone.

Spend your afternoons by the heated pool, unwind in our courtyard retreat, or start your day with a coffee from our iconic lobby cafe. Inside your apartment, enjoy oversized windows that fill your space with natural light, an in-home washer and dryer, and thoughtfully selected finishes that elevate every detail. Schedule a tour today and discover a community where connection, creativity, and comfort come together to make the everyday extraordinary.

desc:
Valeur Lofts is a brand new luxury apartment building featuring 41 modern loft residences within a landmark 1925 building in the heart of Columbus Park on Main Street. The units include 22 thoughtfully designed studios with efficient, open-concept layouts ideal for the modern professional and 19 spacious one-bedroom, one-bathroom residences with generous living areas. Every apartment includes an in-unit washer/ dryer, a modern kitchen with custom wood cabinetry, stainless steel appliances and stone countertops, oversized windows, central air conditioning, and keyless smart entry. The historic building features an art-deco lobby and hallways with arched ceilings, terra cotta tile, original doors and terrazzo floors. The building is steel-and-concrete construction, offering residents a quieter living experience. 24/7 private access fitness center. Pet-friendly. Walk Score 96. Located on the corner of Main and Atlantic, with immediate access to the restaurants and entertainment on Main and Summer Streets. A 10-minute walk to the MetroNorth Stamford Train Station with access to NYC.

NOW LEASING FOR DEC. 1st MOVE-IN.
